abstract.text: Set up LinkMap on your device and start organizing places and shared work.

inlineContent.text: Install LinkMap on your device, then open it. Make sure your device is signed in to your Apple Account in Settings and has access to iCloud. LinkMap uses that account for your Projects; you do not need to sign in separately inside the app.
Use the iOS app to create and manage Projects, add Locations, plan Activities and Routes, and share a Project with collaborators.
The app opens on the Map. Open Dashboard to choose what you are working on.
To start a new Project, choose Dashboard → Add Project and give it a name.
Open Dashboard → Context and select the Project you want to use.
Open Dashboard → Current Project to see and manage its details.
If someone has invited you to a Project, open their invitation or use Dashboard → Scan to scan its QR code. After joining, select the shared Project in Context.
Use the Map toolbar’s Edit Locations action to add or move places. Save to keep your changes or Cancel to discard them. Tap a Location marker and choose Detail to learn more about it.
You can start with a simple Project map. Add Regions and Layers when you need to organize separate areas or levels. See
When you are ready to plan work, create an Activity in your Project. Add a Route using your Locations as Stops, then create an Assignment for the person or team following it.

In Dashboard → Context, select the Activity and, if needed, an Assignment. Return to the Map to see the route and focus on that team’s work. Archive the Activity when the work is over; your Project and its places remain available for another visit.

abstract.text: Learn how to organize places and work in LinkMap on iOS and the web.
Follow one Project from a first place to a planned visit.
Bring places, routes, and shared work together on a map.
The Map is the first screen in LinkMap. It stays visible even before you choose a Project.
A Project brings together the places and activities for one area or shared effort.
Share a Project when other people need to see and work with the same places and Activities.
Open LinkMap in a browser to explore places and view your Project map.
